Font sources. The TTF/BDF files are data only: tools/gen_font.py rasterises them into src/fonts/*.cpp
and include/font_aa.hpp, the firmware never reads them. The shipped UI font is Atkinson Hyperlegible
Mono (4 bits per pixel) at four cell sizes: 12 px = 6 px advance, 16 px = 8, 24 px = 12, 48 px (Home
readings, digits only) = 24 px advance. Spleen stays vendored as the 1 bpp fallback
(python3 tools/gen_font.py --source spleen).

atkinson-hyperlegible-mono/  Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono (variable, wght axis 200..800), font version 2.001,
  SIL OFL 1.1 (OFL.txt), Copyright 2020-2024 The Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono Project Authors.
  https://github.com/googlefonts/atkinson-hyperlegible-next-mono/raw/main/fonts/variable/AtkinsonHyperlegibleMono%5Bwght%5D.ttf
  kept: AtkinsonHyperlegibleMono[wght].ttf  sha256 5ce8b1698d1ded7dff2178c1a3ad159470085a58ea239e8b2cb88f4fb4a6f646
        OFL.txt                             sha256 1ebb31cf7393164f20d10c1d48406cddb5314feff8465531cf1e4ba37e9dd740
  Downloaded on the host into an empty directory; the TTF hash was checked again against a second download.
  Weight pinned per size in memory by tools/gen_font.py (fontTools instancer): 12 px 500, 16 px 450,
  24 px and 48 px 400. Rasterised with FreeType's light auto-hinter, one size fitted per role.
  It lacks the four arrows U+2190..U+2193 the firmware uses; those come from jetbrains-mono/ below,
  scaled to the same cell width. Every other glyph of the firmware set is Atkinson's own.

jetbrains-mono/  JetBrains Mono 2.304, SIL OFL 1.1 (OFL.txt). Used for the borrowed arrows only
  (U+2190..U+2193) and by docs/ui_mockups/render_mockups*.py.
  zip sha256 6f6376c6ed2960ea8a963cd7387ec9d76e3f629125bc33d1fdcd7eb7012f7bbf (details in SOURCE.txt)

spleen/          Spleen 2.2.0, BSD-2-Clause (LICENSE), (C) 2018-2026 Frederic Cambus. Fallback source
  (--source spleen): 12 px = 6x12, 16 px = 8x16, 24 px = 12x24, 48 px = 16x32 scaled 3/2 (nearest
  neighbour, advance 24, 30 px digits).
  https://github.com/fcambus/spleen/releases/download/2.2.0/spleen-2.2.0.tar.gz
  tarball sha256 ec42925c6b56d2138c862b2f97147c872e472f674bf03423417d827a08d69a89
  kept: spleen-6x12.bdf   sha256 fc0743d164690f99b7e2e1b9d503180e4c719a9831ae03fd8f6da18c857dee27
        spleen-8x16.bdf   sha256 4a3d97ee61a8c86a7525d8c723cb8a14081f395cd2feb4227ba5e3baf0629bae
        spleen-12x24.bdf  sha256 181989f2c5f47b34c2474cd424b387b0002aa77fc970e59ee31e16733af24687
        spleen-16x32.bdf  sha256 f6db2549d46c5699ceca7ccc26e747c8bdad3af76239f86aae6ed995bd2f3d37
        LICENSE           sha256 f33fe8679d5b2abecc4f1313ce6c6bfa58262964de5f7bca146596a7318047af
  Hand-drawn in tools/font_overrides.py: 6x12 lacks U+03A9 (Omega), U+2191, U+2193; 12x24 lacks
  U+03A9, U+2190, U+2191, U+2192, U+2193. 8x16 and 16x32 have every glyph the firmware uses.
  Evaluated and rejected: spleen-32x64 (sha256 46897e4c11aec89547805c329b1e8fb572f7580ccb2f7217f5b82aff3b035a71)
  for the Home readings: 40 px digits leave no gap between the three 44 px rows and their gauges.

Spleen archives were downloaded on the host into empty directories and only the BDF text files were
parsed (tools/gen_font.py parse_bdf: keywords only, nothing executed). The TTFs are read by FreeType and
fontTools only on the host, at generation time.
